table.name: TLGNR_TRAILER_TRSP_CAT_BS
table.description: Transport categories for Trailers. Transport categories of truck/trailer/wagon/container generally define what kind of 'packaging' can be transported. For a trailer, the categories are similar to truck transport categories.

column.name: TRAILER_TRSP_CAT_CD
column.description: PK. Code of the Reference Data. 1=Silo, 2=Container, 4=Stueckgut/Mixed Goods (i.e. for pallets). Note that 3 is not in use to avoid confusion with truck transport categories.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
